q: Do we remove emissions when obsolete stock is written off?
title: Obsolete stock written off
short: No. The emissions from making or buying the stock were counted when that happened, and a write-off does not undo them. Do not change earlier years. If the stock is scrapped, its disposal is waste from operations, Category 5. Recording write-offs helps explain rising intensity.

ul: Disposal route: sold as scrap, recycled, landfilled.

p: Products made and scrapped add emissions without sales, so note them when intensity per unit sold rises.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
